tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Discover the Jungle Leopard A200 Plus CPU Cooling Fan

The Jungle Leopard A200 Plus is a high-performance CPU cooling fan built to deliver efficient heat dissipation and reliable thermal management for modern PC builds. Designed with a powerful heatsink and a high-speed fan, it ensures your processor runs cool even under heavy workloads. Its optimized airflow and low-noise operation make it ideal for gamers, creators, and everyday users looking for quiet, dependable cooling.

With wide socket compatibility, durable construction, and easy installation, the A200 Plus is a practical choice for anyone seeking a balance between performance and value.

Jungle Leopard A200 Plus CPU Cooling Fan – Specifications

  • Type: Air Cooler (Heatpipe)
  • Socket Compatibility: Intel: LGA 1150, 1151, 1155, 1156, 1200, 1366, 1700 AMD: AM2, AM2+, AM3, AM3+, AM4, AM5, FM1, FM2, FM2+
  • Heatsink Dimensions: 95 × 65 × 130 mm
  • Fan Dimensions: 92 × 92 × 25 mm
  • Fan Speed: 1600–2300 RPM (±10%)
  • Airflow: 28–48 CFM
  • Noise Level: 20–30.5 dBA
  • Bearing Type: Oil Bearing
  • Power Consumption: 2.76 W
  • Voltage: 12 V DC
  • Current: 0.23 A
  • Connector: 3-pin PWM
  • LED Lighting: RGB Multicolor
  • Fan Life Expectancy: 50,000 hours
  • Mounting System: Tool-free installation
  • Weight: Approximately 500 g
